thread:
Robin Lee: Quick note from a support triage: new dev reported "Unauthorized" in the quickstart. They couldn't tell if key was invalid, org-scoped, or missing model permission. We should make these errors actionable in the SDKs.

Jonas Müller: Agreed. We should have a stable machine-readable 'error_code' (like `AUTH_INVALID_KEY`, `ORG_MISMATCH`, `SCOPE_MISSING`) plus a human `message`. That lets sample apps show a clear CTA.

Priya Gupta: Also include a short `kind` enum: `auth`, `perm`, `rate_limit`, `client`, `server`. Clients can switch on kind without parsing strings.

Maya Patel: Love the enum idea. Can we also surface `support_id` (UUID) and `incident_hint` when we detect correlated errors? Helps support link logs to incidents.

Jonas Müller: Yes. Suggest error shape: { "error_code": string, "kind": string, "message": string, "retryable": bool, "retry_after": int|null, "support_id": string|null, "help_url": string|null, "params": { ... } } — params for resource names/scopes.

Priya Gupta: For parity: propose SDKs expose typed types/classes mapping to those fields. Example Go error type:```go
type APIError struct {
  Message    string
  Code       string
  Kind       string
  Retryable  bool
  RetryAfter int
  SupportID  string
  Params     map[string]string
}
func (e *APIError) IsRetryable() bool { return e.Retryable }
```

Robin Lee: Nice. In JS/TS we can export string literal unions for kind + code enums so switch statements are exhaustive. Also we should have helper predicate functions: `isAuthError(err)`, `isRateLimit(err)`.

Maya Patel: UX text for onboarding: 401 -> "Check API key and workspace" with link to quickstart; 403 -> "Ask admin to grant model scope or change org settings"; 429 -> "You're sending requests too fast, we'll retry automatically (see logs)". Keep copy short and actionable.

Jonas Müller: Edge-case: streaming sessions can return a `resume_span` or `cursor` in the params so apps can resume without losing state. Make sure runtime includes that.

Priya Gupta: Telemetry: SDKs should log `error_code` + `support_id` to client-side logs (respecting PII). Server should return `support_id` on 4xx/5xx so support can correlate.

Robin Lee: One more: define canonical retry semantics per `error_code` in the spec (e.g., `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` -> exponential backoff with jitter + honor `retry_after` if present). That stops every SDK implementing slightly different backoff logic.

Maya Patel: I'll draft a tiny sample app update showing: typed catches, using `kind` to decide UX, and a backoff helper that reads `retry_after`. Will include short copy variants.

deploy-bot: Deploy to staging succeeded (deploy-2026-03-23-0915) :white_check_mark:

Priya Gupta: Action items: Maya write sample update + copy, Jonas add error schema to SDK spec, Robin add helper PR templates for language SDKs. Target: next Tue.

Robin Lee: Thanks all — this should make onboarding less guessy and reduce tickets.
